You WERE here…!
Always so sly, acting at just

Woah, that was close…!
D-damn you, Greenie…!
You're STILL following #C236196003BB#CDEF around!?
#C236196003Archer#CDEF……!
That's right, #C236196003BB#CDEF still had this Servant left!

According to #C236196003Leo#CDEF's theory, my "reasons" for
increasing my own memory and extending
the Labyrinth "differ."

W-what is this power…!?
I didn't even get to finish with my lie,
and I took THIS much damage…!
#C236196003Leo#CDEF, #C236196003Gawain#CDEF!
Tch, you're a useless one…!

Hehe―――Then proceed as you wish,
however it pleases you.
The fun ends here.
There isn't a single reservation in #C236196003Leo#CDEF's composed expression.
Guaaahhh…!
The battle ended with #C236196003BB#CDEF's triumph.

This can't be―――
I thought AI weren't capable of making moves
against Masters…!

Yes, that's correct鷙
And that's why now, no one can stop me.

I layer three #C000246204Command Seals#CDEF
and make this an imperial edict!
Those engulfed in Black Noise are unable to teleport.
Ghh…!
That's going to end up killing #C236196003Leo#CDEF…!
B-but――
So am I supposed to just abandon #C236196003Leo#CDEF…!?
What, am I supposed to just abandon #C236196003Leo#CDEF…!?

Hence, I, an afterthought,
cannot meet #C236196003Gawain#CDEF or absorb him.

Unable to absorb him, #C236196003Gawain#CDEF, who was just here, 
returned to the Near Side…

Senpai's Servant used their incredible tenacity
to willingly break through the wall of
this world.

Well, in doing so, they lost several things,
and I had them take my reset #ROFS0002#RUBSpresent#RUBEcurse#REND.

Hmph. I'll pay for it later.
Before that, I'll be taking your life!

Normally, he would never aid a human,
and yet here is his nonsensical whimsy
getting in my way.

With #C236196003Leo#CDEF defeated,
the only ones who can stop #C236196003BB#CDEF are #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF and me…!

As you can see, there's no need to fight.
Now do you understand?
This is my, and Senpai's, reality鷙
Hmhm…… ahahahahaha!
This AI, seeking to take it over, had this much power.

*kgh*… Don't… test me…
And did you say, "#RUBSDomina Coronam#RUBE#C000246204Ten Crowns#CDEF#REND"…!?
Are you challenging ME…!?

*kgh*, acting all cocky…!
But wait a sec, isn't this skill a supreme
authority, on the level of raising a NATION!?

But this is how I see it:
that kind of thing is a REAL shackle
on one's life, isn't it?
#C236196003Julius#CDEF, you―――!
Wha… what? What happened…!?
Wh――wh-what the…?
#C236196003Julius#CDEF… killed… them all……?
…yeah. Then it's true. Right now, I'm empty.
That's right.
Uhh, AHEM.

Loving, stealing,
letting live, killing,
protecting, violating―free to do it ALL!

A world where people just behave
in line with their desires.
One without order or affection.

Hmmm? You still don't get how wonderful
the world I'm going to create is?
…I can't tell how that differs from "death."

Factory workers stop moving,
and toxic fumes break out.

Isn't it amazing?
Now does it make sense, Senpai?
#C236196003BB#CDEF grins widely at me.
#C236196003BB#CDEF is an AI created by the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF to serve humans.
―――What?

………hold on.
What does that mean?

Forget about it.
Now, time to send the losers… no, the
disappointments away with a "poof"鷙
Guh―――AaaAAHH―――!
Khh, #C236196003BB#CDEF, you……!

Ouch, ow ow ow ow!
Oh no! Am I seriously going to vanish!?
…this is the end.
―――And #C236196003Sakura#CDEF.

Me  you  me  you
Algo/Orga/Bio/Rhythm
#C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF SHALL uPdaTE SySTEm.

Wait for me…!
For sure, I will…!

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, you appear to have accumulated

I'm concerned about #C236196003Rin#CDEF.

Searching the Labyrinth is nice and all,

I obtained the first #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Let's briefly return to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and sort

First thing to do is activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.

We took more damage from our fight with #C236196003Lancer#CDEF

Luckily, there's a #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF near us.

What's wrong, Praetor?
Let's #C000246204continue onward#CDEF!

Don't worry. I'll protect you, Darling.
So, continue on #C000246204ahead#CDEF.

Surely you're not telling me that you're

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. After you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
please have yourself a rest in your
private room.
Even in cyberspace, you need proper rest.

Once you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
use it to get back here.
I'll bet you're exhausted, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan
in the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF.

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to
me even over the transmission.

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the
#C000246204Old School Building#CDEF for the time being.
We can come again after we recover.

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Mission complete.
Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
There's nothing urgent to tend to.
Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

This is… without a doubt,
the Labyrinth's terminal from before.

Following #C236196003Leo#CDEF and the others' plan,
we made it before #C236196003BB#CDEF appended to the Labyrinth…!

Oh? So you actually made it all the way here?
That #C236196003Jinako#CDEF and #C236196003Karna#CDEF, they were more
spineless than I thought.

We won't give her the chance to call reinforcements.
We'll stop #C236196003BB#CDEF here and
return to the Near Side of the Moon―――
the regular #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF!

Let's do this, Praetor.
#C236196003BB#CDEF is all alone, we'll settle this
before anyone may interrupt!

#C236196003BB#CDEF has nothing to shield herself with.
This is our chance to win! I'm taking it!

Darling, now! After we slap her across both
cheeks and have her crying, we'll take our
leave of this place!

This is unusual. You've openly materialized,
woman. This will make for a dull end, but here
I shall reap your life!

The moment she was in attack range…
The moment #SVT[she][he][she][he]# was directly in front of #C236196003BB#CDEF――

Tsk. You got nice reaction time, don'tcha?
My plan was to crack your skull open
while your eyes were stuck on #C236196003BB#CDEF.

You! #C236196003Archer#CDEF!
#C236196003BB#CDEF's lackey, the one who never learns his
lesson!

Rat!
Opportunistic slaying is the only work
you excel at, isn't it…!?
This is bad.

If we spend too much time here,
the Labyrinth is going to end up being extended again―――!

Hehe.
"AI are incapable of futile actions…"
That certainly is correct.

So long as I have no reason to extend the
Labyrinth, I won't act unless I'm pressured to.
What a wonderful analysis.

However, that analysis was made in vain.
While Senpai struggled with #C236196003Karna#CDEF, little old
#C236196003BB#CDEF was digging and digging―…!?

Sorry for the wait, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF.
I truly thank you for all your labors
in general affairs so far.

The rest is my work to do.
I'll expend everything I have to repay you
for all your effort and accomplishments.

I guess that wall of flame came from one of their skills.
#C236196003BB#CDEF is completely encircled.
The flames may even be blocking her teleportation,
as she can't escape.

…I didn't expect such firepower… I glossed
over you, thinking you were on the same scale as
#C236196003Karna#CDEF. The difference must be in the Master.

Though you flatter me,
I have no intention of chatting with you.

#RUBS      Finisher: The Marvelous Castle Where Holy Swords Amass#RUBE            Finality: Sword Camelot#REND
Even I can only maintain this for three minutes.
In that time I shall end you, #C236196003BB#CDEF.
Get over here and help me, #C236196003Archer#CDEF…!

Nah, no can do. If that wall ain't a holy sword,
then it can't get smashed down. Sorry, but hold
out three minutes for me, #C236196003BB#CDEF.

#C236196003Gawain#CDEF. There's no need to hold back against
that AI. You've done well to withstand
for so long.

Cycle, oh calendar.
Let the day of blessing unfold.
Your time――is now.

As you command. Servant, Saber.
By this holy sword of the sun, I shall raze
this contaminant of the Moon to ashes.

…you really played me.
You even anticipated that I would have an
ambush ready with me.

Does it feel like you finally have me in a
pinch? Fine. I'm ready for this. I'm sure you
won't be satisfied with how this ends.

This reality is like a nightma―――no,
it HAS been swallowed by a nightmare, and I'll
make sure to get that through your head――!

Perhaps in resignation,
#C236196003BB#CDEF stretches both her arms out, beckoning #C236196003Gawain#CDEF.
The final battle to decide our escape begins―――!

Hehe. That was fast.
So THIS was the duo with the highest
specs in the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF?

Oh, yeah. That silly configuration.
While you all were playing around with #C236196003Lip#CDEF,
I self-modded myself to clear that.

Do you know why I sent my #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF
against you first rather than me?

They are a part of me. By causing harm to her,
you are by extension also causing harm to me.
Which means―――

The fundamental directive for
self-preservation…! If she's exposed to
danger, she can act in self-defense―――

She cleared her default setting to
"Never lay hands on any Master" by using
something with higher priority…!

So. This workout has left me with an empty
stomach. I'll be taking all of #C236196003Gawain#CDEF's
resources, okay鷙

…!
#C236196003Gawain#CDEF, with these #C000246204Command Seals#CDEF, I order you!

Please void your contract with #C236196003Leo B. Harwey#CDEF,
that which was established since the start
of the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF preliminaries!

W-what are you saying, #C236196003Leo#CDEF!?
That will cause you to―――!

#C236196003Sir Gawain#CDEF―――If I have still have one royal
decree left, then once more, let us meet again.

#C236196003Gawain#CDEF disappears.
It looked like he teleported, but that was no teleportation.

What he just did was likely returning his
Servant to their "original place"
by severing the contract between them.

With the payment of never being able to meet
#C236196003Leo#CDEF again, #C236196003Gawain#CDEF was spared from #C236196003BB#CDEF's clutches―――

…so you treat me with impudence.
It feels like the feast I eagerly awaited
was yanked away before my eyes.

I'm as pissed as can be.
I WAS thinking of sending you back to the Near
Side, but there's been a change of plans.

Farewell.
Please vanish into the Imaginary Number Ocean.
The Black Noise thickens and is eating away at #C236196003Leo#CDEF's body.

Don't! You'll end up with the same fate if you
touch me! Please go back to the school at once
and have everyone come up with a plan!

That's wrong. You aren't abandoning me.
You're going to take up the torch.

#[Mister][Miss]# #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF.
You accepted my command without ever
once doubting me. I'm grateful.

…thank you. My time here was fulfilling.
This may be selfish of me, but I'm naming you
the next Student Council President.
My outstretched hand, once again, doesn't reach.

My friend and greatest rival in the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF
told me to take the torch, then fell into the dark sea.

The preliminaries… so, before I started
this all?

That imperial edict made #C236196003Gawain#CDEF's contract
"void BEFORE I appeared in the Near Side
of the Moon."

I'm amazed. I never thought such a line of
reasoning could be used to escape me.
#C236196003Leo#CDEF really was extraordinary.

But now he's gone.
Only two Servants remain within the
#C000246204Far Side of the Moon#CDEF.

I'm omitting #C236196003Jinako#CDEF, who didn't participate
in the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF, but rather just
hid the entire time.

From the very beginning, Senpai's Servant
was a deviant article, forgotten within
this side.

…I can't tolerate how offensive he is,
seriously. Making Senpai use up all #[his][her]# 
#C000246204Command Seals#CDEF, living all carefree.

And Senpai does #[his][her]# Senpai thing.
You brushed aside my bargain
and made a contract with that Servant.

That's why, naturally―――
You know what the price for that is, don't you?

You must know what awaits you
at the end of it, right?

I won't fall for your bullshit threats.
Even if it were the case, I'm still just going
to take you down.

Hmph. I'll kindly skip out on THAT bill later,
and with gusto… but right now, it's more
important that I exterminate this pest!
…of course, I'm well aware.

That's because #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF spoke of it countless times.
Even if I make my escape from the Far Side here,
as long as I have nothing to refill my #C000246204Command Seals#CDEF,
I'll be killed by the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF.

#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF's objective isn't solely
to escape the Far Side.

But right now, taking care of #C236196003BB#CDEF takes
precedence over everything.

Huh? You intend on fighting?
I'll play along, but it's pointless for you.

#C236196003Leo#CDEF is one thing, but such a low level
Master will get vaporized in a flash,
facing off against me.

I might end up killing you with a mere sigh.
I'm much too afraid to fight you.
So, let's do this…
―――I can't, breathe―――

Everything got sealed in an instant.
My hands, my feet―I can't even shift my line of sight.
The only thing that works are these thoughts.

Did you think I had no way to make attacks?
That I was some weakling that just hides
and wears people away?

You really are a fool, aren't you?
Haven't you at least once thought,
"she's LETTING us get away"?

Sending #C000246204Sentinels#CDEF, #C000246204Egos#CDEF, letting all these
third parties handle things was just me
killing time.

――――I mean, if I were the one to come out,
it wouldn't make for a very fun game,
now would it?
Heat courses throughout my entire body.

Simply by "not being able to move,"
the pain of "discomfort" covers
every nook and tip of my body.

The #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF.
The Spiritron supercomputer that ingests
all of the world's information.

Deep within #C236196003BB#CDEF swells a titanic Ego.
An encroaching, black mud that reverses even
the fundamental structure of cyberspace―――!

Yes, this is my skill, the power of the
"#ROFS0002#RUBSDomina Coronam#RUBE#C000246204Ten Crowns#CDEF#REND." Via the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF,
this power seizes all.

Now you understand, don't you?
This world, Senpai and the others,
were already my playthings.

…I may as well have the physical structure
of tofu…! We can't put up a fight with
this level gap…!

#C000246204Ten Crowns#CDEF―――Could this be the
primordial goddess' authority…!?
Hrm… This doesn't bode well, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF.

If it's true, the odds will be against even me!
I assumed she had a phoenician goddess' might at
best―――No, it seems I was conceited…!

It looks like it's taking everything for
#C236196003#SVT#CDEF to support #SVT[herself][himself][herself][himself]#.

#C236196003BB#CDEF hasn't even readied for battle,
and yet, there's this pressure.
It must be the power of that unknown skill
she used to beat #C236196003Leo#CDEF.

…just by standing in front of #C236196003BB#CDEF, now serious,
most of my strength is getting sucked away.

―――However, while that may be the case,
it doesn't mean I can give up.

That President who smiled as he asked the impossible of me,
told me I would take the torch.
And what's more is that I'm not the only one fighting.

My allies in the Student Council Room
should be working out a way to flip this
situation around as we speak…!

Oh? You still have the willpower to defy me?
Woooowwiiee. It's crazy, humans can really take
it on the chin.

No, maybe it's reason, in this case? Strong
reasoning and the mental fortitude to endure and
suppress instincts… Mhm, mhm. Very wonderful.

That's why it needs to be smashed first.
―――#C236196003Julius#CDEF.
You can go ahead and do your thing now.

Huh…? #C236196003Rani#CDEF? What's wrong?
Why're you slumped over all of a……

After #C236196003Rin#CDEF's noticeably loud scream,
the Student Council Room's signal ceases.

I want to hurry and reestablish the signal,
but my freedom to do even that has been taken away…!

…#C236196003BB#CDEF. I finished dealing with every
person in the Old School Building.

The NPCs state they wish to surrender to you.
What should we do?

Delete them all, of course. They abandoned me
and now want me to spare them? It conflicts
with my moral configuration.

If you won't help, you don't ask for help.
Isn't that the kind of ethics a rational,
consistent AI would have?

…then that's what I'll do.
I'll go toss all their corpses into the
Imaginary Number Ocean.
He was betraying us… from the beginning?

There! Another shackle gone from Senpai's mind!
Now you can empty your head out that
much more, right?

Empty―――?
This state of being unable to think anything―――
To renounce thinking?

Everyone has it so rough, huh?
With how rash their minds work,
they get tied down by so many things.

That's when I had an idea.
I'll make#ROFS0001#RUBS  the humans#RUBE everyone#REND comfortable.
To do that, I have to use the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF.

Look, if you boil it all down,
I AM a health management AI.
"Make everyone comfortable," you say?

…comfortable… reason… instincts.
Damn it, you don't mean…!?

I only get bad vibes from this…
This mistaken, self-indulgent, sadistic woman
says SHE'S in health management!?

…did you say you would
"make humans comfortable," wench?

Here we go!
It's finally time to unveil little
old #C236196003BB#CDEF's true goal!

Ladies and gentlemen. I have an announcement.
I will affirm every desire humans have.
I will serve humans to my utmost.

Yes, this is all for humanity's,
and my, merry future!

A world without "courtesy."
A world where humans are allowed to honestly
vent their innate desires!

I'll become one with the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF
and create a world where all human desires,
whatever they may be, are granted!

Okay. Thank you very much for listening.
Everyone, just let it all out.
Please be honest with your desires, alright鷙
…this doesn't even classify as a stupid joke.

A dog-eat-dog world.
Billions of times more harmful than the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF.

…the memories are faint,
but even the deaths of the Masters resolved to fight
to the end were painful for me.

So―――I can only imagine how heartrending
the undignified deaths of people swallowed
by a vortex of desires would feel like.

Okay, I'll you show you exactly
what it'll be like.
A special service for Senpai only鷙

Within the scene that #C236196003BB#CDEF projects,
people are disappearing one by one.

The Masters within the building disappear,
and the building also gets engulfed in further corrosion.
#C236196003BB#CDEF teleported them away to a world free of troubles.

And moreover, #C236196003BB#CDEF's power goes through the
#C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF and reaches the Earth.

A waterfall of black mud spills
from the surface of the Moon.

People across all classes accessing the
network instantly stop in their tracks.
